label: Joint-absence power: weaker than total refraining, compatible with necessary production
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, finite controls with GOD_4 read as the holder g and the possibility reading of PowerFor (y has at w a power for p when p holds at an accessible world where y exists). (1) On a three-world frame (no creature, c, d) the total-refraining sibling, Euclidean access, monotone powers and 0050b6ed's proposition all hold. (2) On the replacement frame (g gives c at false and d at true) 0050b6ed's proposition, Euclidean access and monotone powers hold, the total-refraining sibling fails, g gives something at every accessible world and #1897's ActualAbsenceByWithholding holds. (3) On the non-Euclidean frame a -> b, a -> c, b -> b the total-refraining sibling and monotone powers hold and 0050b6ed's proposition fails. (4) On the three-world frame with a non-monotone, maximally specific power the total-refraining sibling and Euclidean access hold and 0050b6ed's proposition fails. Each model witnesses only its formal interpretation; the possibility reading has no causal content and the maximally specific power is an encoding artifact.
